title: Seriously needs to improve
text: In my opinion the only box that has actually been worth it is the venom box, all the other ones have just kind of been trash. They seriously need to add more to these boxes to make it worth while for the customers. I un- subbed for x-men thankfully and I'm re-subbing for captain marvel. Hopefully it's actually worth it. This will probably be the last chance I give the box.
label: negative
